items.period: Shang period (script-style identification on Commons page; modern digital redraw)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of a Shang-style 星 form, presented by the source as combining star-related imagery with 生. It illustrates a proposed early form, not an excavated inscription photograph.
items.alt: Black line drawing of an archaic Chinese character form on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The file is specifically identified as 星 in Shang oracle-script style and the page names its model and reuse terms. It can illustrate the early-form proposal while the textual evidence records disagreement about whether 生 was present in the earliest forms.
items.rights: The Commons description states a public-domain dedication for the SVG representation, for international use.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw attributed to the HB2813 source form, not a photograph of an ancient bone; the account of which components the earliest graph contains is disputed.
